method.textKeyComparison: exact trimmed text; Access collation not inferred

method.privacy: No row samples, names, addresses, customer numbers, seller numbers, passwords, free texts, raw paths, binary contents or personal date ranges in output.
method.dates: Access civil date/time is represented by the reader as Date with Z; this is not evidence of a source UTC time zone. Customer/personnel date ranges suppressed.
method.systemData: System schemas and row counts only; MSysRelationships metadata read explicitly.
method.externalData: Linked tables and external file references recorded without resolving paths or fetching URLs.
